title: Fantastic scent!!
text: Fantastic scent!!. The smell of the cinnamon sachets is fabulous!  I sell online and tuck these in the tissue paper, which I use for wrapping. Gives the paper a nice scent! Am eager to try other fragrances!

product_metadata.title: FloralSimplicity Sachets Winter Cheer (Fall and Winter) 3 Pack - Long Lasting, ECO-Friendly Home Fragrance Perfect for Any Space Air Freshener - Scents for Rooms - Made in The USA
features: DEODORIZER - Fill your space with the fantastic aroma of FloralSimplicity"s Scented Sachets! These sachets may be small, but they produce a robust delightful scent that will neutralize any smelly odor and freshen the space!
LONG-LASTING FRAGRANCE: Enjoy the lush, aromatic scent of Cinnamon Stick on a cozy day! This sweet and spicy fall scent is perfect for the holidays but meant for you to enjoy all year long!
MULTIPLE USES - Great for the kitchen, bathroom, closets, backpacks, cars, gym bags, - Made In The USA We're committed to making the world a better-smelling place, one sachet at a time.

GREAT GIFT: Include in seasonal or themed gift baskets and crafts for a perfect perfume for your senses and spa experience. Give a gift to friends and family for Mother's Day, a housewarming, wedding shower, baby shower, birthday, or any special occasion.
ECO-FRIENDLY - Made by American hands from start to finish and crafted with minimal environmental impact in mind using recycled and biodegradable materials.
